title: hardening: preserve legacy/malformed SavedData migration invariants
body:
Follow-up extracted from stale draft PRs #39 and #40 after Stage 07 was completed through PR #91/#95/#96.

The PR branches themselves are obsolete and must not be merged: they target an old `main`, implement schema v1, and would regress the current schema-v2 persistence/lifecycle behavior. However, their reviews identified two additional fail-closed invariants that are not visibly implemented in current `main` (`eaddc3232dfc600780769f4a5e7e45ff1e50181c`) for both `DepositRegistry` and `TectonicRegionState`:

1. **Legacy migration durability** — an unversioned/released-v1 payload is read and serialized as current schema v2, but `fromTag(...)` does not currently mark the loaded `SavedData` dirty solely because migration occurred. Add a regression contract proving a successful legacy→current migration schedules persistence of the current schema without requiring an unrelated later mutation.

2. **Malformed top-level container preservation** — `CompoundTag#getList(..., TAG_COMPOUND)` returns an empty list on a wrong NBT type. A malformed `deposits`/`regions` root can therefore become an empty writable state instead of being preserved fail-closed/read-only. Add regression coverage and preserve the malformed payload or otherwise guarantee it cannot be destructively normalized/overwritten.

Affected current classes:
- `src/main/java/dev/gustavopere/volcanoes/geology/DepositRegistry.java`
- `src/main/java/dev/gustavopere/volcanoes/tectonics/TectonicRegionState.java`

Provenance of findings: reviews on #39 and #40. Those draft implementations should remain historical only; any fix must be developed fresh from current `main` with the current schema-v2 and lifecycle contracts intact.

- proves dormant volcanoes retain their 24,000-tick coarse cadence;

title: fix(rns): preserve foreign custom deposit ownership
body:
## Scope

Fixes the post-merge RNS custom-deposit ownership hazards found after PR #82. Volcanoes must never adopt or destructively remove a foreign `CustomServerDepositLocation`, while legitimate Volcanoes projections must remain removable after normal RNS save/load and server restart.

## Root cause

Create: Rock & Stone `1.3.1-1.21.1-6` persists `CustomServerDepositLocation` with only deposit `id` and `location`. Its loader reconstructs a new host object from only those values. Therefore an external Volcanoes side ledger plus `(structure, chunk, precise center)` cannot distinguish, after restart, the original Volcanoes record from a foreign exact-value replacement.

The final contract removes that ambiguity by persisting ownership proof in the RNS host record itself.

## TDD evidence

### Pre-existing foreign identity

`exactHostNeverAdoptsOrDeletesPreExistingForeignCustomIdentity` was added first.

RED: RNS Hydrothermal Acceptance `33319133845`, job `99277883665`.

### Same-session exact-position replacement

`exactHostNeverDeletesForeignReplacementAtSamePreciseLocation` was added before its production fix.

RED: RNS Hydrothermal Acceptance `33320055108` failed specifically with `historical ownership must not authorize deleting a foreign exact-position replacement`.

### Malformed duplicate side-ledger NBT

A unit regression was added before changing the ownership parser.

RED: Volcanoes CI `33320055120` failed in `Unit tests`.

### Restart continuity

`exactHostRebindsPersistedOwnedProjectionAfterWriterRestart` was added first in `7e84a309e67c2170dca14cdf121a718f188c71c4`.

RED: RNS Hydrothermal Acceptance `33320944464`; 24 GameTests ran and only the new restart test failed.

### Foreign exact replacement while writer is down

Fresh Codex review then demonstrated that restoring deletion authority from side-ledger values remained unsafe. `exactHostRestartMustNotAdoptForeignExactReplacement` was added first in `b27fdfa4682bcb8860547929d9ca1c8d98751894`.

RED: RNS Hydrothermal Acceptance `33323644712`; 25 required GameTests ran and only this new regression failed with `persisted side-ledger values must never make a restarted writer adopt a foreign replacement`.

## Final ownership contract

- Volcanoes adds a narrow Mixin to the exact RNS `CustomServerDepositLocation` host class.
- Volcanoes-owned locations carry `volcanoes_owner_source_id`, the exact authoritative Volcanoes source UUID, on the host object itself.
- the marker is written by the RNS location's own `serialize()` path and restored by its `of(...)` deserialization path;
- `RnsProjectionOwnershipData` remains auxiliary historical/diagnostic state and never grants destructive authority by itself;
- an occupied RNS identity without the matching host-local marker is foreign/unknown and is never adopted or removed;
- `ensurePresent` may rebind after restart only from a reconstructed host record carrying the matching owner marker;
- `ensureAbsent` may delete only a host record carrying the matching source marker and exact precise center;
- a foreign removal/recreation at the same id/chunk/center has no Volcanoes marker and therefore fails closed;
- no-host identities clear stale auxiliary attribution without touching RNS state;
- malformed/conflicting duplicate auxiliary ownership remains fail-closed.

The mixin config is optional; the RNS writer itself is still installed only behind the existing exact-version compatibility gate. If the marker surface is unavailable, projection fails closed rather than reverting to value-based ownership inference.

## Persistence proof

`exactHostOwnershipMarkerSurvivesRnsNbtRoundTrip` forces the real RNS `LevelDepositData.serializeNBT(...) -> deserializeNBT(...)` path, verifies the serialized custom location contains the exact Volcanoes owner UUID, reconstructs the host object, then requires safe rebind and removal.

Final RNS Hydrothermal Acceptance `33324064114` loaded exact RNS `1.3.1-1.21.1-6` + KubeJS `2101.7.2-build.368` and passed **all 26 required GameTests**.

## Exact final head

`ce758af08296fe6230279cc9fa1a3958b232b961`

All canonical gates GREEN on this exact head:
- Volcanoes CI `33324064118`;
- RNS Hydrothermal Acceptance `33324064114` — 26/26 required GameTests;
- Worldgen Compatibility Matrix `33324064113` — WG-00 through WG-07 successful;
- Cold Sweat Heat Acceptance `33324064099`;
- MineColonies Claim Acceptance `33324064131`.

All Codex findings raised on this PR were reproduced or otherwise covered by targeted regressions, answered with evidence, and resolved. A fresh final Codex review is requested on this exact head before merge.

Stage 07 remains unopened. Final Stage 06 documentation will be reconciled only after this ownership fix lands on `main`.
